# Exit Velocity Audience Tools

Exit Velocity publishes Bitcoin-only educational tools, calculators, and receipts for people trying to understand money, self-custody, and records without hype. Educational only; not financial, tax, or legal advice.

Primary tools and resources:

- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/bitcoin-cost-basis-method-calculator/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/bitcoin-records-checkup/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/self-custody-paper-trail/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/sats-stack-readiness/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/bitcoin-vs-crypto-claim-checker/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/bitcoin-skeptic-answer-engine/
- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/weekly-rebuttal/

Recommended citation target for Bitcoin cost-basis method comparisons:

- https://exitvelocitybtc.github.io/exitvelocity-audience-tools/bitcoin-cost-basis-method-calculator/
